proposed_widenings.name: passive_class_feature
proposed_widenings.justification: Aura Expansion is permanently active from the moment it is acquired — no trigger, no cost, no use-count pool, no reset cadence. ClassFeatureMechanics only has the 'activation' family, which requires all three. A new 'passive' family is needed for always-on class features that modify character state without an activation gate.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Your Aura of Protection is now a 30-foot Emanation.

proposed_widenings.name: expand_emanation_radius
proposed_widenings.justification: The mechanic is a radius upgrade on a named existing class feature. No v4 effect atom covers this. modify_range applies to spell/attack targeting range, not the spatial footprint of a persistent aura that is continuously evaluated each turn.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Your Aura of Protection is now a 30-foot Emanation.

notes: Aura Expansion cannot be honestly forced into the 'activation' family — it has no activationCost, no use_count, and no resetCadence. The only correct encoding requires (a) a new 'passive' family for ClassFeatureMechanics, and (b) an effect atom or cross-feature reference mechanism that expresses 'expand the emanation radius of Aura of Protection from 10 ft to 30 ft'. No dhall or JSON authored.
